name: Accordion · onboarding week
description: Orange gradient onboarding checklist with numbered steps.

items.question: Day 1 · Meet your buddy
items.answer: You will be paired with a teammate who answers questions and shows you the ropes.

items.question: Day 2 · Set up your tools
items.answer: Laptop, accounts and access arrive before you start. We will walk you through the rest.

items.question: Day 3 · Ship something small
items.answer: Pick a starter task and get a change live. It is the best way to learn the codebase.

items.question: Day 5 · Share your first impressions
items.answer: A relaxed catch-up with your manager to talk about what is working and what is not.
